personality_one_liner: A professional, data-dense, and highly legible terminal-grade market application prioritizing clarity and trust.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly. Do not have extra spaces where not required. Use compact spacing inside scannable widgets for data density.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism for this terminal/data-dense app to ensure absolute clarity.
dont's: No blur overlays behind text that decrease readability.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A dense market overview presenting quick IPO summaries and top movers.

states.error: Unable to fetch market data. Retry.

screens.layout: Grid of summary stat cards (Highest GMP, Closing Today). Clean horizontal scrolling lists for featured IPOs. Strict alignment and minimal chrome.

screens.name: IPO List
screens.purpose: Comprehensive directory of all IPOs with powerful segmenting and filtering.
screens.layout: Sticky segmented control for tabs (Open/Upcoming/Closed/Listed) and a Mainboard/SME toggle chip. Each card displays tight tabular data (Issue Size, Price Band, GMP) with status indicators.

screens.name: IPO Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific IPO with fundamentals, subscription metrics, and AI analysis.
screens.layout: Header with company logo and issue status. Stacked blocks for GMP Trend Chart, Subscription Bar Breakdown, Timeline, and a dedicated AI Business Summary text block. Use bottom sheet for allotment probability calculator.

components.status_tabbed_ipo_card: A compact card. Top row: Logo, Company Name, Status Badge. Bottom row: 3-column grid for Price, GMP (with gain indicator), and Issue Size. Minimal padding (md).
components.summary_stat_card: Small square widget (2-col grid). Title in muted text, large metric number (Space Grotesk), small trend indicator (+X%).
components.gmp_trend_chart: Clean line chart. No gradients. Solid line with points. X-axis for dates, Y-axis for GMP value.
components.subscription_bar: Stacked horizontal bar or multi-segment progress bar showing QIB, NII, Retail quotas. Legend below.
components.filter_bottom_sheet: Gorhom bottom sheet holding grouped checkboxes and sliders for issue size, GMP %, and sectors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement both Light and Dark modes reading from the structured color tokens.
Strict adherence to no blue/indigo/purple colors. Use the provided near-black/dark-gray baseline with exact semantic green (gain) and red (loss).
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for standard UI text and 'Space Grotesk' for display numbers, metrics, and large titles to create a financial terminal feel.
Ensure the UI layout is highly data-dense. Reduce unnecessary padding inside metric widgets.
Status indicators (Upcoming, Open, Closed, Listed) must use the exact status tokens provided.
Avoid glassmorphism to prioritize data readability.
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the Screeners and Filters view.
